title: Hard questions and easy ones
hook: Two stated cases: explore the direction of a calibration gap across difficulty.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the direction of a calibration gap across difficulty affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the direction of a calibration gap across difficulty in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
